title: Cards
tagline: Nine card games in one app — Mau-Mau, Hearts, Skat, Doppelkopf, Schafkopf, Hold'em, Rommé, Bridge and Canasta. Online, or any seat played by the computer.
description:
Cards packs nine of the classic European and American card games into one table: Mau-Mau, Hearts, Skat, Doppelkopf, Schafkopf, Texas Hold'em, Rommé, Bridge and Canasta. Each game is a complete rules engine with bots, so a table is never short of players.

Play solo against the computer at an Easy or Normal level, ask the hint button to suggest a move, and keep a win/loss record per game. Open a room and invite friends through GameHub — the room creator hosts, bots hold empty seats, and a dropped player's seat is taken over until they come back. Procedurally drawn cards, an animated table, synthesized sound, German and English UI, and it installs as a PWA so a solo game works offline.
highlights: Nine games with full rules engines and bots
Multiplayer rooms over GameHub — bots fill empty seats
Installable PWA: solo play works offline, UI in German and English
